headline: A 2006 executive order directs federal health care programs to promote higher-quality and more efficient health care.
what_it_does: This order sets goals for health care programs that the federal government runs or pays for, focusing on care quality and efficiency. Only the title was provided, so the specific rules, steps, and deadlines it sets cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run or sponsor health care programs
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to take steps aimed at improving the quality and efficiency of the care their programs pay for or provide.

who_it_affects.group: People covered by federal health programs
who_it_affects.how: They may see changes in how their federally run or sponsored health coverage works, though the exact changes are not stated in the title.
